rows.note: Use 項 for a distinct entry in an account or a distinct point on an agenda.

example.english: There is one item on this bill that I don't understand.
example.traditional: 呢張單有一項收費我唔明。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 daan1 jau5 jat1 hong6 sau1 fai3 ngo5 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use 件 for a distinct physical object, especially when counting or identifying objects.

example.english: This item is mine, so don't take the wrong one.
example.traditional: 呢件係我嘅，你唔好拎錯。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 nei5 m4 hou2 ling1 co3

rows.note: Use 題目 specifically for a question or problem on a test or examination.

example.english: This test item is so hard that I have no idea how to do it.
example.traditional: 呢條題目咁難，我完全唔識做。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tai4 muk6 gam3 naan4 ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sik1 zou6

rows.note: Use 一對 when item means two people understood as a romantic couple.

example.english: They really are an item; they go out together all the time.
example.traditional: 佢哋真係一對，成日一齊出街。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jat1 deoi3 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 gaai1
